source_semantics.toggle: The source Sites workspace uses ToggleSelectAllVisibleAsync to select all currently visible sites and changes the same control to Clear visible when that visible set is selected.
source_semantics.local_state: The operation changes only browser selection state; it does not persist, enqueue, call WordPress, or claim mutation success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/sites-bulk-delete-control.tsx binds AIMW-BILL-F8102254A8 to the real visible-selection button, computes allVisibleSelected from rendered site IDs, selects the visible set up to the governed 100-site cap, and removes that same set when already selected.
laravel_adaptation.read_contract: The rendered set comes only from the authoritative tenant-scoped sites endpoint already required by SitesBulkDeleteControl.
laravel_adaptation.mutation_boundary: Toggle selection performs no DELETE request; the separate RequestBulkDelete and ConfirmBulkDelete operations retain destructive ownership.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING operation identity, low risk, tenant-owned and non-mutation metadata
production operation marker on the real select/clear visible control
frontend behavior selects every rendered site then clears the same visible set
selection toggle makes no mutation request
